title: Pre-Adamic cosmic war wipes out the civilization on Mars

tellings.quote: in that process, in this conflict, the civilization on Mars was eviscerated.

plain: Long before Adam, a war in the heavens is said to have been fought across the solar system, and in that conflict the civilisation on Mars "was eviscerated." Tim Alberino tells Michels this as his own summary, building on ideas he credits to David Flynn and to works titled Cydonia and Birthright. If true, it would mean Mars once held a civilisation destroyed in a cosmic war before human history began.
